content: {"reasoning":"The missing-authorization denial has already been appealed, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; similar appeals succeeded in 0 of 7 cases. Correcting the invalid diagnosis pairing would not resolve the authorization requirement. CO-197 assigns contractual responsibility to the provider, and neither the deductible nor coinsurance establishes patient liability for this denied service, so no collectible patient or secondary balance is established.","action":"write_off"}
